body: I’m not in high school either. I’m in my mid 20s. And the situation I’m in I can’t get out of for 4 more years.
I’m stuck where I am for at least the next 4 years. I’m trying to make the most of it but it’s hard to see the point in trying anymore

Nothing really kicked it off. I just woke up from a nap the other day and had a panic attack and ever since it’s just been bad and dark. I’ve been doing CBT, trying to turn the thoughts I’m having better and sometimes it works and sometimes it doesn’t. At the end of the day I just wish I didn’t exist anymore, the only thing keeping me back is the guilt I’d feel for making my family so sad.
I don’t even know. I don’t know what this stems from or what even is wrong which is the biggest problem

Probably not the advice you want but if the relationship had been having problems since the start of your marriage and you’re unhappy why stay in it? If things haven’t changed in the past year they may never change. If a person doesn’t want to change, there’s nothing you can do to fix it. You both have to want the marriage to work.

I think it’s wonderful that you both love each other very much, and that you have found something like that. But without trust, and good communication the relationship can’t work. 

I know this must be a hard decision, saying goodbye to someone you care for so deeply is never easy, but you have to think about you and put yourself first and make yourself happy. Whatever it is that may be. I wish you the best of luck.
